messages.content: What is Sky Theft?

Sky Theft is an open-world action crime game made by Sky the Goat. You play as **Kevin King**, a 21-year-old who starts out alone and broke in the dangerous city of **Darkwood**. You explore the city, drive powerful cars, fight armed enemies, buy weapons, pull off robberies and earn SkyCash as you build your name.

It's in **open beta** right now. The latest build is **Open Beta 0.9.2, the Restaurant Update**, and it's free to download from skytheft.net for Windows 10 and 11.
Tell me about Sky Theft.

Sky Theft is an open-world action crime game by Sky the Goat, built in Unreal Engine 5 with C++.

**The story:** Kevin King is 21, alone, and broke in Kevin's Brick Box, his small home in one of Darkwood's poorest neighborhoods. What starts with a home robbery pulls him into the city's criminal underworld, between rival gangs, dangerous criminals and a police force determined to bring him down.

**What you can do:**
- Plan and pull off robberies
- Outrun the cops with wanted levels from 1 to 5 stars
- Drive nine cars, including the Bugatti Tourbillon
- Buy six weapons from the Weapons app
- Earn SkyCash, invest in SkyStocks and buy the Modern House
- Run everything from your phone, Sky Mobile

The current build is Open Beta 0.9.2 (the Restaurant Update, October 20, 2026). It's free during the beta at skytheft.net.
what's sky theft about

Sky Theft is about **Kevin King**, a 21-year-old trying to survive in **Darkwood**, a city ruled by crime. He lost both of his parents three years ago and lives alone in Kevin's Brick Box. With little money, he starts taking dangerous jobs, and a home robbery pulls him deeper into the criminal underworld. Your journey starts at the bottom. How far will you rise?
Describe Sky Theft in one sentence.
Sky Theft is an open-world action crime game by Sky the Goat where Kevin King rises from broke and alone to fighting for control of the crime-ruled city of Darkwood.
What kind of game is Sky Theft?

Sky Theft is an **open-world action crime game**. It has driving, shooting, robberies, police chases and a story, a bit like GTA, but it's Sky the Goat's own original game set in the city of Darkwood.
What genre is Sky Theft?
Open-world action crime. You explore the city of Darkwood, drive, fight, rob places and outrun the police while following Kevin King's story.
Is Sky Theft out?

Yes, you can play it now! Sky Theft is in **open beta**. The latest build is **Open Beta 0.9.2 (the Restaurant Update)**, released October 20, 2026. It's free during the beta. Download it from skytheft.net for Windows 10 or 11.
Is Sky Theft finished?

Not yet. Sky Theft is in open beta, so the world, missions and story are still evolving during development. The current build is Open Beta 0.9.2. Sky the Goat keeps adding new things with each update, like Sky Burger and the Bugatti Tourbillon in the Restaurant Update.
Who made Sky Theft?
Sky Theft was made by **Sky the Goat**, who is the game's creator and developer. Sky the Goat also made me, Sky AI!
Who is the developer of Sky Theft?

Sky the Goat is the developer of Sky Theft. Sky the Goat builds the game in Unreal Engine 5 with C++ and also makes music for it. The first official radio track in the game, "One Take", is by Sky the Goat.
What engine is Sky Theft made in?
Sky Theft is made in **Unreal Engine 5** and programmed in **C++**. It uses DirectX 12 and supports ray tracing and DLSS.
What programming language is Sky Theft written in?
Sky Theft is written in **C++** in Unreal Engine 5.
When did Sky Theft development start?
Development of Sky Theft began around **August 2026**, in Unreal Engine 5 with C++. By October 2026 it was already in open beta with Open Beta 0.9.2.
Is Sky Theft made by Rockstar?

No. Sky Theft isn't made by Rockstar Games. It's an independent game made by Sky the Goat in Unreal Engine 5. It's an open-world action crime game like GTA, but it's its own original game with its own city, Darkwood, and its own main character, Kevin King.
Who is Kevin King?

Kevin King is the main character of Sky Theft. He's **21 years old** and lives alone in **Kevin's Brick Box**, his small home in one of Darkwood's poorest neighborhoods. Kevin lost both of his parents three years ago and has had to make his own way ever since. He wants something simple: peace, stability and a better life. But in Darkwood, nothing comes easy.
Who is the main character in Sky Theft?
The main character is **Kevin King**, a 21-year-old who starts the game alone and broke in Darkwood. His journey starts at the bottom, and the game is about how far he can rise.
What is Darkwood?

Darkwood is the city where Sky Theft takes place. It's a dangerous city where rival gangs fight for control, crime fills the streets, and trouble can find you around any corner. It's still growing during the open beta, with more of the city added in updates.
Where does Sky Theft take place?

Sky Theft takes place in **Darkwood**, a crime-ruled city. Kevin King starts in one of its poorest neighborhoods, in his small home, Kevin's Brick Box. The map keeps expanding throughout the open beta.
What is Kevin's Brick Box?
Kevin's Brick Box is Kevin King's small home in one of Darkwood's poorest neighborhoods. It's where the story of Sky Theft starts. Later you can earn enough SkyCash to buy the **Modern House**.
What happened to Kevin's parents in Sky Theft?
Kevin lost both of his parents three years before the story starts. Since then, he's been forced to make his own way in a city that offers little mercy.
What's the story of Sky Theft?

**The Story of Darkwood:** *In a city ruled by crime, survival is only the beginning.*

At just 21, Kevin King lives alone in Kevin's Brick Box in one of Darkwood's poorest neighborhoods. Three years ago he lost both of his parents. He wants peace, stability and a better life, but with little money and few opportunities, he starts taking dangerous jobs to survive.

What starts with a **home robbery** soon pulls him into the city's criminal underworld. As he completes missions, earns money and builds his reputation, he gets caught between rival gangs, dangerous criminals, and a police force determined to bring him down. Every decision carries consequences, and every mission brings new opportunities and new enemies.

Kevin isn't just fighting for money anymore. He's fighting for control over his future. If he ever wants peace, he might have to confront the very forces tearing the city apart.

*Can Kevin rise above the chaos and find a way to change Darkwood, or will the city consume everything he's fighting for?*
How does Sky Theft's story start?

It starts at the bottom. Kevin King is broke and alone in Kevin's Brick Box, so he starts taking dangerous jobs to survive. His first big step is a **home robbery**, which pulls him deeper into Darkwood's criminal underworld.
How does Sky Theft end?

I don't know how Sky Theft's story ends. The game is in open beta and the story is still evolving during development, so the ending may not even be finished yet. The big question the game asks is whether Kevin can rise above the chaos and change Darkwood, or whether the city will consume everything he's fighting for. Play it to find out!
Who are the villains in Sky Theft?

Kevin gets caught between **rival gangs**, **dangerous criminals**, and a **police force** determined to bring him down. I don't know the names of specific villains, and the story is still being developed during the open beta, so check skytheft.net for the latest.
What is Kevin fighting for in Sky Theft?

At first Kevin just wants to survive and get money. But as the story goes on, he isn't just fighting for money anymore. He's fighting for **control over his future**. He wants peace, but he might have to confront the very forces tearing Darkwood apart to get it.
What's the latest Sky Theft update?

The latest update is **Open Beta 0.9.2, the Restaurant Update**, released **October 20, 2026**. It adds:

- **Sky Burger**, a brand-new restaurant on the map
- **Bugatti Tourbillon**, the fastest car in the game: 320 MPH, or 600 with boost
- **Ford Mustang**, a classic convertible for cruising Darkwood
- **A bigger, better world**: more of Darkwood, a real day and night cycle, a starry night sky, and draw distance up to Epic

It's a 1.10 GB ZIP for Windows 10/11, free during the beta at skytheft.net.
What's new in Sky Theft Open Beta 0.9.2?

Open Beta 0.9.2 is called **The Restaurant Update** (October 20, 2026). Sky Burger opens its doors in Darkwood, and two new cars hit the streets:

- **Sky Burger**: a new restaurant location
- **Bugatti Tourbillon**: 320 MPH top speed, 600 MPH with boost
- **Ford Mustang**: a classic convertible
- **World**: more of Darkwood, a full day and night cycle, a starry night sky, and draw distance up to Epic

All on top of everything that was already in Open Beta 0.9.
What version is Sky Theft on?
The current version is **Open Beta 0.9.2**, the Restaurant Update, released October 20, 2026.
What is the Restaurant Update?

The Restaurant Update is Sky Theft **Open Beta 0.9.2**, released October 20, 2026. It added the **Sky Burger** restaurant, the **Bugatti Tourbillon** and **Ford Mustang**, a full day and night cycle, a starry night sky, more of Darkwood, and draw distance up to Epic.
What is Sky Burger?
Sky Burger is a brand-new restaurant in Darkwood, added in Sky Theft's Restaurant Update (Open Beta 0.9.2, October 20, 2026).
What is the current Sky Theft build number?
Sky Theft is on **Open Beta 0.9.2**. Before that came Open Beta 0.9. Sky the Goat also showed an earlier **Alpha 0.5** build in a full gameplay showcase on the YouTube channel.
What were the previous Sky Theft updates?

Here's the recent update history:

- **Open Beta 0.9.2: The Restaurant Update** (Oct 20, 2026, 1.10 GB): Sky Burger, Bugatti Tourbillon, Ford Mustang, a full day and night cycle, and more of Darkwood.
- **October 9, 2026 build** (1.06 GB): the F-150, a speedometer, the gas-station robbery, SkyStocks, deeper settings, the trainer engine, and add-on cars.
- **Police & Arsenal Update** (Oct 4, 2026, 992 MB): fully working police AI, the Bronco i340 and Sky Beamer, the AK-47, sniper rifle and shotgun.

Full build notes for every update are on skytheft.net.
What was in the Police & Arsenal Update?

The **Police & Arsenal Update** came out on October 4, 2026 (992 MB). It added **fully working police AI**, two cars, the **Bronco i340** and **Sky Beamer**, and three weapons: the **AK-47**, a **sniper rifle** and a **shotgun**.
When was the gas station robbery added to Sky Theft?
The gas-station robbery came in the **October 9, 2026** build, along with the F-150, a speedometer, SkyStocks, deeper settings, the trainer engine and add-on cars.
When did the police get added to Sky Theft?
Fully working police AI was added in the **Police & Arsenal Update** on October 4, 2026.
Where can I read the Sky Theft patch notes?
Build notes for every update are on the official website, **skytheft.net**. The site also has every car and weapon, the trainer and mods, and public bug reports.
How do I download Sky Theft?

1. Go to the official website, **skytheft.net**.
2. Click **Download free beta** (or **Download Open Beta 0.9.2**).
3. Download the **ZIP file** (about 1.10 GB).
4. **Extract the full folder**. Right-click the ZIP and choose *Extract All*.
5. Open **SkytheftrebornDev.exe** inside the extracted folder.

It runs on Windows 10 and 11 and is free during the beta. Only download it from skytheft.net.
How do I install Sky Theft?

Installing Sky Theft takes three steps:

1. **Download the ZIP file** from skytheft.net
2. **Extract the full folder**: right-click the ZIP and choose *Extract All*
3. **Open SkytheftrebornDev.exe**

Make sure you extract the whole folder first. Running the .exe from inside the ZIP won't work properly.
Which file do I open to play Sky Theft?
After extracting the ZIP, open **SkytheftrebornDev.exe**.
Sky Theft won't start when I open it from the zip

That's because the game needs all of its files. Running it from inside the ZIP only gives Windows the .exe.

1. Right-click the Sky Theft ZIP and choose **Extract All**.
2. Open the extracted folder.
3. Run **SkytheftrebornDev.exe** from there.

If it still won't start, report it on the bug reports page at skytheft.net so Sky the Goat can look into it.
How big is Sky Theft?
The current download, Open Beta 0.9.2, is a **1.10 GB ZIP**. Make sure you have extra free space for the extracted folder too.
Is Sky Theft free?
Yes, during the beta. Sky Theft is **free during the open beta** while it's being tested. The finished full release is **planned to be a paid game**.
Will Sky Theft cost money?
The open beta is free. The finished full release is planned to be a paid game. I don't know the price yet, so check skytheft.net for updates.
What platforms is Sky Theft on?

- **Windows PC (10/11)**: open beta, playable now with keyboard, mouse or controller
- **Android**: in testing, for controls and performance

No other platforms have been announced.
Is Sky Theft on Android?
Sky Theft on **Android is in testing**, focused on controls and performance. Right now the playable open beta is on Windows 10 and 11.
Is Sky Theft on PlayStation or Xbox?
No console versions have been announced. Right now Sky Theft is in open beta on **Windows 10/11**, and an **Android** version is in testing. Check skytheft.net for news.
Is Sky Theft on Steam?
I don't know of a Steam release. Right now you get Sky Theft from the official website, **skytheft.net**, where the open beta is a free ZIP download for Windows 10/11.
Can Sky Theft run on my PC?

Sky Theft runs on **Windows 10 and 11**, and the download is 1.10 GB. I don't know the official minimum specs. For reference, the website says it runs at about **60 FPS on an RTX 4060 at 1440p** with DLSS Quality and near-max settings with ray tracing, though performance varies by area and system. On a weaker PC, try lowering the draw distance and fog settings and turning off ray tracing.
Is Sky Theft safe to download?

Download it only from the official website, **skytheft.net**. That's where Sky the Goat posts every build, and it even shows a SHA-256 checksum for the latest download. Don't download Sky Theft from random reuploads, because those can contain malware.
Does Sky Theft have a Discord?
Yes! There's a **Join the Discord** link on the official website, skytheft.net. It's a good place to talk with other players and follow updates.
Where can I watch the Sky Theft trailer?
**Sky Theft | Official Trailer #1 - Open Beta Available Now** is on Sky the Goat's YouTube channel (**sky thegoat**, @skythegoat999), and it's also embedded on skytheft.net under *See it in motion*.
What can you do in Sky Theft?

In Sky Theft you can:

- **Explore Darkwood**, a growing open-world city
- **Pull off robberies**: plan them in the Notes app, then hit targets like the Sky Fuel gas station
- **Outrun the cops**: wanted levels go from 1 to 5 stars
- **Drive nine cars**, including the 320 MPH Bugatti Tourbillon
- **Buy weapons** like the AK-47, M40 Sniper and Tommy Gun Sky
- **Earn SkyCash**, invest in **SkyStocks**, and buy the **Modern House**
- **Use Sky Mobile**, your in-game phone
- **Eat at Sky Burger**
- **Turn mods on and off** with the built-in Mods app
How do robberies work in Sky Theft?

Here's how a robbery works in Sky Theft ("Plan the score"):

1. **Plan it** in the **Notes** app on your phone, Sky Mobile.
2. **Travel to the target.** Your first robbery is the **Sky Fuel gas station**.
3. **Fight through the opposition.**
4. **Grab the valuables.**
5. **Get home and save.**

Causing trouble raises your wanted level, so be ready to outrun the cops.
What's the first robbery in Sky Theft?
Your first robbery is the **Sky Fuel gas station**. Plan it in the **Notes** app on Sky Mobile, travel there, fight through the opposition, grab the valuables, then get home and save.
How does the wanted level work in Sky Theft?

Sky Theft has **wanted levels from 1 to 5 stars**. The more trouble you cause, the harder the police come after you in their cruisers. The police have fully working AI, added in the Police & Arsenal Update.
How do I lose the cops in Sky Theft?

The more trouble you cause, the higher your wanted level (1 to 5 stars) and the harder the police chase you. General tips:

1. **Get a fast car.** The Bugatti Tourbillon does 320 MPH, or 600 with boost.
2. **Break line of sight** with turns and side streets.
3. **Don't keep fighting**, because more trouble means more police.
4. **Get home and save** once you're clear.

If you just want to mess around, the optional **Max Power Trainer V4** has **Never Wanted** and **Clear Wanted Level** options.
What is SkyCash?

SkyCash is the money in Sky Theft. You earn it from robberies and missions, keep it in **Sky Bank**, spend it on weapons in the **Weapons** app, invest it in **SkyStocks**, and save up for things like the **Modern House**. Prices are shown as SC, like **SC 1,000** for the AK-47.
What is SkyStocks?
SkyStocks is the stock market app on Sky Mobile in Sky Theft. You can **invest your SkyCash** in it. It was added in the October 9, 2026 build.
Can you buy a house in Sky Theft?
Yes! You start in **Kevin's Brick Box**, a small home in one of Darkwood's poorest neighborhoods, and you can earn SkyCash and buy the **Modern House**. More mansions are planned for future updates.
How do I make money in Sky Theft?

You earn **SkyCash** by completing missions and robberies, like the Sky Fuel gas station job. Then you can grow it by investing in **SkyStocks**. Your balance is in the **Sky Bank** app on your phone. If you just want to play around, the optional Max Power Trainer V4 has unlimited money.
How do I save in Sky Theft?
Open your phone, **Sky Mobile**, with **P** (or **D-Pad Down** on a controller) and use the **Save** app to save and load your progress. Your weapons carry over between saves.
Do weapons save in Sky Theft?
Yes. In Sky Theft your weapons **carry over between saves**, so you keep the guns you bought.
Does Sky Theft have car damage?
Yes. Cars in Sky Theft **take real dents, catch fire, and explode**.
Does Sky Theft have a day and night cycle?

Yes. Sky Theft has a **full day and night cycle** with real sunsets and a starry night sky. Street lights and headlights switch on at night. The full day and night cycle came in Open Beta 0.9.2, the Restaurant Update.
Is Darkwood alive?

Darkwood is built to feel alive: **people walking, busy traffic**, and a **crowd-size slider** to control how busy it is. Street lights and headlights switch on at night, and cars take real dents, catch fire and explode.
Does Sky Theft have missions?

Yes. As Kevin King you complete missions and robberies to earn money and build your reputation, and every mission brings new opportunities and new enemies. The world, missions and story are still evolving during the open beta.
How do I open the phone in Sky Theft?
Press **P** on keyboard, or **D-Pad Down** on a controller, to open **Sky Mobile**. Press it again to close it. The game keeps running while the phone is open.
What is Sky Mobile?

**Sky Mobile** is Kevin's phone in Sky Theft: *the city in your pocket*. Open it with **P** or **D-Pad Down**. It runs your money, cars, guns, saves and mods while the game keeps going. Apps:

- **Sky Bank**: your SkyCash balance
- **Weapons**: the armory, to buy guns and ammo
- **Vehicles**: your cars, plus a Mod Cars section
- **Travel**: get around Darkwood fast
- **Notes**: plan your next robbery
- **SkyStocks**: invest your SkyCash
- **Save**: save and load your progress
- **Mods**: turn add-ons on and off, reload, open the folder
- **Developer**: testing tools
- **Settings**: graphics, draw distance, fog and controls
What apps are on the Sky Theft phone?
Sky Mobile has: **Sky Bank**, **Weapons**, **Vehicles**, **Travel**, **Notes**, **SkyStocks**, **Save**, **Mods**, **Developer** and **Settings**.
How do I fast travel in Sky Theft?
Use the **Travel** app on Sky Mobile (press **P** or **D-Pad Down**) to get around Darkwood fast.
Where do I buy guns in Sky Theft?
Buy guns and ammo from the **Weapons** app on your phone, Sky Mobile. Open the phone with **P** or **D-Pad Down**. Then switch between your weapons with the weapon wheel.
How do I get my cars in Sky Theft?
Open Sky Mobile (**P** or **D-Pad Down**) and go to the **Vehicles** app. It has your cars, plus a **Mod Cars** section for add-on cars.
What does the Notes app do in Sky Theft?
The **Notes** app is where you **plan your next robbery**. Your first plan is the Sky Fuel gas station.
What is the Developer app in Sky Theft?
The **Developer** app on Sky Mobile has **testing tools**. It's there because Sky Theft is in open beta.
What guns are in Sky Theft?

Sky Theft has six weapons, bought from the **Weapons** app on your phone:

| Weapon | Price | Fire | Ammo |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Pistol Prototype** | Free | Semi-auto | 12 mag |
| **Tommy Gun Sky** | SC 500 | Full auto | 50 drum |
| **Pump Shotgun** | SC 700 | Pump | 8 shells |
| **AK-47** | SC 1,000 | Full auto | 30 mag |
| **M40 Sniper** | SC 1,200 | Bolt action | 5 mag |
| **Sky Theft Grenade** | SC 25 | Thrown | Carry up to 6 |

Your weapons carry over between saves, and the weapon wheel switches between them.
What's the best gun in Sky Theft?

It depends on the fight:

- **AK-47** (SC 1,000): full auto, 600 rounds a minute, 30-round mag. A great all-rounder.
- **Pump Shotgun** (SC 700): nine pellets per shot, deadly up close.
- **M40 Sniper** (SC 1,200): bolt action with a scope that has 3 zoom levels, for long range.
- **Tommy Gun Sky** (SC 500): full auto with a 50-round drum, the most ammo per reload.

The AK-47 is a strong pick for most situations.
What gun do you start with in Sky Theft?
You start with the **Pistol Prototype**. It's free, semi-automatic, and holds 12 rounds per magazine.
Tell me about the AK-47 in Sky Theft
The **AK-47** costs **SC 1,000**. It's full auto, fires **600 rounds a minute**, and has a **30-round magazine**. It was added in the Police & Arsenal Update on October 4, 2026.
Tell me about the Tommy Gun Sky
The **Tommy Gun Sky** is a classic full-auto gun with a big **50-round drum**. It costs **SC 500** in the Weapons app.
How does the sniper work in Sky Theft?
The **M40 Sniper** costs **SC 1,200**. It's bolt action with a 5-round magazine, and its scope has **3 zoom levels**.
How does the shotgun work in Sky Theft?
The **Pump Shotgun** costs **SC 700**. It fires **nine pellets per shot**, so it's strongest up close, and it holds 8 shells.
Are there grenades in Sky Theft?
Yes. The **Sky Theft Grenade** costs **SC 25**. It's thrown, has a **2.5-second fuse**, and you can carry **up to 6**.
How do I switch weapons in Sky Theft?
Use the **weapon wheel** to switch between the guns you own.
What cars are in Sky Theft?

Sky Theft has **nine cars**, and every car has its own top speed and a boost. Some of them:

- **Bugatti Tourbillon**: the fastest car in the game, 320 MPH or 600 with boost
- **Ford Mustang**: a classic convertible, 120 MPH or 270 with boost
- **F-150**: added in the October 9, 2026 build
- **Bronco i340** and **Sky Beamer**: added in the Police & Arsenal Update

See every car with screenshots on the **Cars** page of skytheft.net. You can also add more with add-on car mods.
What's the fastest car in Sky Theft?
The **Bugatti Tourbillon**. It's the fastest car in the game: **320 MPH**, or **600 MPH with boost**. It was added in Open Beta 0.9.2, the Restaurant Update.
How fast is the Bugatti in Sky Theft?
The **Bugatti Tourbillon** has a top speed of **320 MPH**, and **600 MPH with boost**.
How fast is the Mustang in Sky Theft?
The **Ford Mustang** is a classic convertible with a top speed of **120 MPH**, and **270 with boost**. It was added in the Restaurant Update.
How many cars are in Sky Theft?
There are **nine cars** in Open Beta 0.9.2, including the Bugatti Tourbillon and Ford Mustang. You can add more with add-on car mods through the Mods app.
What is boost in Sky Theft?
Every car in Sky Theft has its own top speed **and a boost** that pushes it past that. For example, the Bugatti Tourbillon does 320 MPH normally and 600 MPH with boost.
Can I add my own cars to Sky Theft?

Yes! Sky Theft supports **add-on cars**. The built-in **Mods** app reads the Mods folder, reloads add-ons, and turns them on or off, and add-on cars work **without replacing the base game**. They show up in the **Mod Cars** section of the Vehicles app.
What graphics does Sky Theft have?
Sky Theft uses **DirectX 12** with **ray tracing** and **DLSS**. It has a full day and night cycle, real sunsets, a starry night sky, a **draw-distance setting from Low to Epic**, and adjustable fog.
Does Sky Theft have ray tracing?
Yes. Sky Theft supports **ray tracing** and **DLSS** on DirectX 12.
How well does Sky Theft run?
On an **RTX 4060 at 1440p** with **DLSS Quality** and near-max settings with ray tracing, Sky Theft runs at about **60 FPS**. Performance varies by area and system.
How do I get more FPS in Sky Theft?

Open Sky Mobile (**P**) and go to **Settings**:

1. **Lower the draw distance** from Epic to High or Medium.
2. **Reduce the fog** setting.
3. **Turn on DLSS** (Quality or Balanced) if you have an NVIDIA RTX card.
4. **Turn off ray tracing** if you need a big boost.
5. **Lower the crowd size** with the crowd-size slider.

Also update your GPU driver and close background apps.
Can I play Sky Theft with a controller?
Yes. Sky Theft has **full controller support** across driving, combat, the phone and menus. Open the phone with **D-Pad Down** and the trainer by clicking **both sticks**.
What are the Sky Theft controls?

Here are the key controls I know:

- **P** (or **D-Pad Down**): open and close your phone, Sky Mobile
- **F8**: free camera, to line up your own shots
- **F4** (or click **both controller sticks**): open the Max Power Trainer V4, if you installed it
- **Hold Q**: radio wheel, and **K** for the next track

The game supports keyboard and mouse or a full controller. You can change controls in the Settings app.
How do I take screenshots in Sky Theft?

Press **F8** for the **free camera**, which lets you line up your own shots. Then use Windows' screenshot tools (**Win + Shift + S**) or your GPU's capture tool (like the NVIDIA overlay, **Alt + Z**).
How do I use the radio in Sky Theft?
**Hold Q** to open the radio wheel and press **K** to skip to the next track. The radio has **Sky the Goat Radio**, and **One Take** by Sky the Goat is the first official track built into the game.
Does Sky Theft have music?

Yes! Sky Theft has a radio, and *the island has its own sound*. Turn on the radio wheel and let the city move around you. **One Take** by **Sky the Goat** is the first official track built into Sky Theft, on **Sky the Goat Radio**.
What is One Take?
**One Take** is a track by **Sky the Goat**, and it's the first official track built into Sky Theft. You can hear it on Sky the Goat Radio in the game's radio wheel.
Can you mod Sky Theft?

Yes, mods are built in! The **Mods** app on Sky Mobile reads the **Mods folder**, reloads add-ons, and turns them on or off. Add-on cars and full trainer menus work **without replacing the base game**. Sky the Goat also made an optional trainer, the **Max Power Trainer V4**.
How do I install mods in Sky Theft?

1. Put the mod in Sky Theft's **Mods folder**. The Mods app can open it for you.
2. In game, open Sky Mobile with **P** and go to the **Mods** app.
3. **Reload** add-ons and **turn the mod on**.

Add-on cars show up in the Mod Cars section of the Vehicles app. Mods don't replace the base game, so you can turn them off anytime.
What is the Max Power Trainer?

The **Max Power Trainer V4** is an optional mod by Sky the Goat for Sky Theft. In game it's called the **Sky Theft Mega Trainer V4**. Press **F4**, or click **both controller sticks**, and you get full control while the game keeps running. Features include:

- **God Mode**
- **Spawn any car**
- **100% Save**
- **Unlimited money**
- **Teleports**
- **Time of day**
- **450 MPH Max Power Rocket**

It also has Heal, Never Wanted, Clear Wanted Level, Infinite Ammo, Give All Weapons, Super Run and Super Jump, across **5 menu pages**. Download it from the **Trainer** page on skytheft.net.
How do I open the trainer in Sky Theft?
Press **F4** on keyboard, or click **both controller sticks** at the same time, to open the **Max Power Trainer V4**. You have to download the trainer from skytheft.net first. It's an optional mod.
Does Sky Theft have cheats?

Sky Theft has an optional trainer mod instead of cheat codes: the **Max Power Trainer V4** by Sky the Goat. Press **F4** (or click both controller sticks) for God Mode, unlimited money, spawn any car, teleports, Never Wanted, Infinite Ammo, Super Jump, time of day and the 450 MPH Max Power Rocket. Get it from the Trainer page on skytheft.net.
How do I get god mode in Sky Theft?
